matrix_rule: M_ij = q_ij - mean_j(q_ij), the row-centered ideal decoded update divided by h_i
normalization_note: Uses public symbols directly; does not add an intermediate FP32 center-decoding roundoff
floor_rule: torch lower median of positive radius.double()*(2/15) across all six public packets
zero_radius_rule: Report count; exclude only from normalized spectral estimates, preserve original packet constraints
beta_rule: partition m/(d-1), unchanged by excluding 16 eigenvalues from fitting
covariance_method: CPU float64 column-chunk Gram minus d*outer(row_means,row_means), reuse principal submatrices
quantile_rank_rule: Original ascending index j uses p=(j+0.5)/m; top16 removed without rescaling remaining CDF
fit_scale_rule: median of observed eigenvalue / unit-variance MP quantile at each retained original probability
mp_quantile_method: theta grid 65537 points, cumulative trapezoid of (2/pi)*sin(theta)^2/(1+beta-2*sqrt(beta)*cos(theta)), normalize numerical mass, monotone interpolation
negative_eigenvalue_tolerance: 100*eps_float64*max(m,d)*max(abs(raw_eigenvalues)); retain raw negatives in output; clip only tolerated negatives for fit
no_fit_fallback: No replacement by zero, h^2/12, or legacy c_mp; report null and explicit reason
subspace_rule: Right singular vectors in original feature coordinates, only eigenvalues above numerical tolerance; keep all 16 attack targets unchanged
reporting: All partitions, raw spectra, fitted scales/edges, fit-window sensitivity, row counts, public radius statistics, runtime and process memory
interpretation: Fit availability is not model acceptance. MP resemblance does not establish iid noise, recoverable image count, or defense strength. No automatic downstream experiment.
